parameters.name: BaselineNameKey
parameters.description: The name of the image baseline check result.

parameters.name: ClusterId
parameters.description:
The ID of the container cluster to query.
> You can call the [DescribeGroupedContainerInstances](~~DescribeGroupedContainerInstances~~) operation to obtain this parameter.

parameters.name: Criteria
parameters.description: The query condition for the baseline.

parameters.name: CriteriaType
parameters.description:
The query type for the baseline. Valid values:

- **BaselineNameAlias**: baseline name
- **BaselineClassAlias**: baseline category.

parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number of the page to return. Default value: **1**, which indicates that the first page is returned.

parameters.name: ImageDigest
parameters.description: The SHA256 value of the image digest.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language type for the request and response messages. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:

- **zh**: Chinese
- **en**: English.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: Settings for paged query paging. The number of image baseline check result details to display per page. Default value: **10**, which indicates that 10 image baseline check result details are displayed per page.

parameters.name: RepoInstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID of the image repository.

parameters.name: RepoName
parameters.description: The name of the image repository.

parameters.name: RepoNamespace
parameters.description: The namespace of the image repository.
